# Awesome Event-based Hand Pose Estimation [![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://awesome.re)

A curated list of papers on **hand pose estimation, hand mesh reconstruction and hand tracking with event cameras**.

**Searchable version (filter by year, venue, type, tag): https://ryhara.github.io/awesome-event-based-hand-pose-estimation/**

14 papers · [2026](#2026) · [2025](#2025) · [2024](#2024) · [2022](#2022) · [2021](#2021)

## Contributing

Additions and corrections are welcome — open an issue or a pull request.

All papers live in [`data/papers.yaml`](https://github.com/ryhara/awesome-event-based-hand-pose-estimation/blob/main/data/papers.yaml). `README.md` and the [web page](https://ryhara.github.io/awesome-event-based-hand-pose-estimation/) are generated from it by GitHub Actions, so **edit only the YAML file**:

```yaml
- title: Paper Title
  authors: [First Author, Second Author]
  venue: CVPR            # short name; use "arXiv" for preprints
  year: 2024
  type: conference       # conference | journal | workshop | preprint
  doi: 10.1109/xxxx      # optional (DOI or URL)
  project: https://...   # optional
  arxiv: 2403.07346      # optional (arXiv ID or URL)
  code: https://...      # optional
  tags: [egocentric]     # optional
```

To preview locally:

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python scripts/build.py      # writes README.md and site/index.html
open site/index.html
```
